lab: EIGRP Successor and Feasible Successor Troubleshooting
topology: PC1–R1–(R2 or R3)–R4–SRV1 routed diamond. All four AS100 neighbor pairs begin working. R1 prefers R2 with server route metric/FD10240 and RD7680. Its known R3 alternate begins at25600/RD12800, failing the feasibility condition. R3 Gi0/1 delay30 is repaired to10; R1 Gi0/2 delay50 and R3 Gi0/0 delay1000 remain intentional.
implemented: Thirteenth ENARSI Layer3 Technologies catalog entry, independent practice/completed instances, six-row addressing/metric plan, staged guide, tested CLI reference and current-origin/path/query permalink. Existing catalog entries remain; ENCOR39 and ENCOR Layer3 nine are preserved.

Fixed topology publication and show rendering: all-links includes received nonfeasible candidates with actual interface/total/RD; default topology contains successors and feasible successors only. Both classifications use the retained historical FD; a promoted successor is not its own FS. This visibility change does not install alternate routes or alter DUAL selection.

Initial diagnosis requires actual three-reply delivery in both host directions over R2 while the R3 alternate RD12800 fails FD10240. Repairing R3 delay creates a standby20480/RD7680 with exactly one installed primary successor, AD90 and metric10240.

Feasible promotion exercise shuts only R1 Gi0/1. The service-prefix entry remains PASSIVE, installs R3 at current metric20480 and retains FD10240 without a service-prefix DUAL ACTIVE. Actual requests in both host directions must bypass R2 through R3/R4 before uplink restoration and fresh preferred-path delivery.

Strict-boundary exercise uses R3 delay20: alternate23040/RD10240 equals local FD10240 and is rejected as feasible. It appears only in all-links. Real primary-path traffic is required before restoration and fresh traffic afterward. Changing a local R1 delay cannot rewrite the remote RD.

Nonfeasible exercise uses R3 delay30 plus R1 primary shutdown. Actual DUAL ACTIVE with pending replies and no installed service route must precede DUAL PASSIVE/newFD25600 and the25600 R3 route. Blocking the actual R3 REPLY holds the route ACTIVE and absent; restoring delivery permits convergence and real alternate traffic. This cannot impersonate immediate feasible promotion.

Local-metric exercise changes R1 primary delay100, making the R2 path33280 while R3 remains20480. Outgoing server requests follow R3 and reverse client requests use still-up R2. Historical FD remains10240. A counterfactual RD12800 is classified nonfeasible even though it is below the current20480 metric; variance also cannot install it.

Both-uplink loss requires exact R1 interface shutdowns, real server No route failures and working three-reply local-gateway delivery. Server power loss or removed cables cannot impersonate it. Restore both ports and prove fresh preferred-path traffic.

Every controlled exercise needs its own actual state/path evidence plus three fresh replies in both directions after restoring the intended baseline. Configuration-only toggles, fewer probes, one-way requests, static shortcuts, rewiring, wrong gateways or unrelated server failures cannot earn these recoveries.

HTTP needs a complete actual200 service response with the correct body, traversing R2. Six live and eight historical criteria yield practice0/14, initial diagnosis1/14, baseline9/14 and full14/14. Reference supplies only six live goals, without invented observations.

Per-attempt config/route epochs and ordinary simulator notifications record actual events with the guide closed. YAML preserves earned history while protocol/transport state rebuilds; new practice resets it. Canonical metric/protocol config replays into clean routers; saved reload restores an unsaved standby fault. UI layout, terminal theme/fonts/controls and icons are unchanged.
scope: Classic IOS IPv4 internal EIGRP, default K-values, variance1 and one AS100 routed diamond. The display fix covers the common IPv4/IPv6 topology publication/rendering path, with broad existing protocol/show regressions retained. No fresh CML capture, exact IOS timing/binary compatibility, complete DUAL input matrix, multipath-share ratios, SIA timing exercise, named/wide-metric conversion or EIGRP authentication expansion is claimed. The ACTIVE interval can be brief and is inspected in simulation events. Existing logical protocol/transport limits remain in docs/audits/eigrp-update-fidelity.md.
